next.whatsNew.2026-11-09c.bashLine.title: Commands with «!» stay in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09c.bashLine.text: A command you run with «!» stays in the feed with its output and the agent's reply, after a reload too.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09c.stoppedTurn.te: When you stop the agent, its thinking and text stay in place marked «Stopped», and any folded turn unfolds in full.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09c.appConsent.tex: When an agent installs an app that needs access, an «Allow» card shows in the chat and its right pane, and an open app shows it over its window. One click and it runs.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09c.previewPathAss: Previews by path come with their styles and scripts

When a preview opens by path (one harnessly address for the whole company), the page now loads the styles, scripts and pictures it names by relative addresses, and the dependencies its loader writes with document.write. Before, it could open unstyled or blank.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09b.codeAsk.title: 2FA and SMS codes, right in the panel
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09b.codeAsk.text: When an agent needs a one-time code (npm publish, a bank sign-in), «Waiting for a code» appears under the subagents: what it is for and how long the agent still waits. The code never goes through the chat and is kept nowhere.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09b.codeField.titl: Six cells, sent on the last digit
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09b.codeField.text: Paste the code whole, or let the phone fill it from the SMS. The last digit sends it and the command starts with it at once. «Cancel» takes the ask off.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09a.pagesList.text: The page list in the viewer's address bar now scrolls, opens on the current page and has a search on top when there are many pages.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08g.designLoader.t: Slides and pages — no blank screen
While a slide or a page loads, you see it loading. It shows only once its fonts, pictures and videos are in.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08f.apiSpend.title: Claude API spend by the message field
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08f.apiSpend.text: When Claude on the machine is paid by the API rather than a subscription, the chip shows what it cost today, by model, instead of limits. The day start is in Settings.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08e.machineCard.ti: All about the machine — in the chat's header
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08e.machineCard.te: Press the machine icon beside the chat's title: its load, what is wrong and the other machines to move to. The same on the new chat screen.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08d.journalWords.t: The app inspector now says «Ran a command», «Opened a terminal», «Stopped an action of the agent», «Wrote a secret into the safe» instead of codes.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08d.trustInSkill.t: The agent knows how to ask for rights
The apps skill explains trust circles and what the person sees at install: apps are written with the least access.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08c.setupSteps.tit: Machine setup steps can be pressed
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08c.setupSteps.tex: A key a step waits for opens the safe; a failed step shows its error and «Retry».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08c.setupCompact.t: A tidier «Not everything is set up» card
Stages fit one row and the picked one is highlighted. A long error takes one line, the whole of it behind «Details».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08b.demoFolder.tit: The Relay demo lives in the «Demo» folder
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08b.demoFolder.tex: The learning projects sit in one «Demo» folder, in new libraries and old ones. «Bring back the demo projects» puts the deleted ones back there.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08b.tourWay.title: Lessons lead to the project, button by button
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08b.tourWay.text: A lesson lights up the way: the «Demo» folder, then the card. If a search or a filter hides the project, it lies in another folder or it was deleted, the lesson offers to clear the view or bring the demo back, and «Back» no longer takes you the wrong way.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08b.boardErrorSend: «Send to the chat» on a board error goes straight to the agent
Looking at a project, it switches to editing, the chat opens and the error goes to the agent: you see your message and the reply. The same on a site and a deck.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08a.libToolbar.tex: Kinds, recent, design system and sorting live in the filter button; new folder, select and the trash are under «⋯». A dot on the button says a filter is on.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08a.libCardMenu.te: The items of a card's «…» menu do what they say again instead of opening the project.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08a.slotPages.titl: Every page of a design opens
next.whatsNew.2026-11-08a.slotPages.text: Decks, videos and sites with several pages no longer stop on the second page with «not found» on a team server.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07zz.appMentions.t: Type «@» and the apps that are on show their finds beside the files and chats: tracker tasks, clients, whatever the app can look up. The one you pick goes into the field.
Your folders and what lies in them are the same whichever machine opens the library.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07z.designExamples: Demo projects in an Examples folder
The Relay site, deck, video and design system for getting to know Sinopia sit in one folder. Rename it or delete it as you like.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07w.appSecrets.tit: Apps keep their keys in the safe
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07w.appSecrets.tex: After you sign in to a service, an app can save the key it got — no need to paste it into a form. It cannot read the key back.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07w.appSecretsShar: Your secrets are replaced only with your yes
An app that asks to replace a secret of yours, such as GITHUB_TOKEN, says so at install, and asks you while the agent is using it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07v.appAI.title: Apps ask a model
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07v.appAI.text: An app can get an answer of a model — a summary or a draft — on your account, with no tools and no access to files.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07v.appAgentsRun.t: An app gives the agent a task
The task goes to a new chat under the current one: you see it in the list and can stop it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07v.appBudget.titl: Each app has its own budget
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07v.appBudget.text: How much an app may spend a day shows at install. When the budget is spent, its calls stop until the next day.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07u.appTerminal.ti: A terminal of your own, as an app
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07u.appTerminal.te: A terminal inside an app is as fast as the usual one and runs in the agent's sandbox: in the chat's folder, without your keys.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07u.appBrowser.tex: With your consent an app looks at pages in the built-in browser and clicks on them. Passwords, files and page scripts stay out of its reach.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07u.appHooks.title: An app can stop the agent
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07u.appHooks.text: A check sees each action of the agent and can stop it. The feed says who stopped it, and one button turns an unwanted check off.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07t.sinopiaSees.ti: The agent sees what is open in Sinopia
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07t.sinopiaSees.te: While a document is open beside the chat, the agent knows which slide or page is on screen and what you selected — no need to explain what you mean.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07t.sinopiaHands.t: The agent turns the pages for you
The agent can show the slide it means or reload it after a change — you see the result at once.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07t.appKeys.title: Your keys work in apps too
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07t.appKeys.text: Apps hear your shortcuts — the ones you set in Keys — and show notices with a tone: success, warning, error.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07s.appRun.title: Apps run commands
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07s.appRun.text: Tests, a build, a linter — by a button in an app, no terminal. A command runs in the same sandbox as the agent: in the chat's folder, without your keys and with a time limit.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07s.appDevServer.t: A dev server in the pane
An app can start a dev server and open it in the browser on the right. The server lives while the app is on in the chat.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07s.appAgentAsks.t: The agent does not go around your consent
When the agent tries to run a command through an app, you are asked and decide yourself.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07q.appFast.title: Apps open faster
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07q.appFast.text: An app's window starts getting ready as soon as you point at it in the sidebar, so the click only has to show the page. And it no longer starts from scratch every time it opens.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07r.appButtons.tit: Apps right at the chat's field
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07r.appButtons.tex: An app that is on can put its buttons beside the field and suggest where to start in an empty chat. A suggestion goes into the field: you send it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07r.appSearch.text: ⌘K finds the commands of this chat's apps and opens any installed app by its name.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07r.appLinks.title: Link cards from apps
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07r.appLinks.text: When an app that is on understands a link in a message, its card shows under it: say, the state of the cashback the link points at.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07n.libFolders.tex: Sort designs, decks and videos into folders: drag cards or use “Move to…”. A folder is your own shelf; it does not change who can open a project.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07n.libFilters.tex: Filter the library by kind, design system or recent work, together with search. Sort by date or name.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07n.libTrash.title: Trash
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07n.libTrash.text: A deleted project goes to the trash: undo it right away, restore it later or delete it for good.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07m.appFiles.title: Apps see the whole chat folder
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07m.appFiles.text: An app can list files, search them and notice what changed — within the folders you agreed to. When it needs one file, it asks you to pick it in a dialog.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07m.appGit.title: Git changes without a terminal
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07m.appGit.text: Apps see git status, diffs and history of the chat's folder; secret files stay out. See the «Changes» app.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07m.appEvents.titl: Apps hear what happens in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07m.appEvents.text: An app can know that the agent finished a turn, called a tool or that a message came — without their content.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07l.appConsent.tit: See what an app gets before you install it
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07l.appConsent.tex: The install screen lists all the access in plain words, the dangerous on top, and says it straight: we do not check apps. An update that asks for more waits for your consent — until then the current version runs.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07l.appSwitch.titl: Turn an app off with one switch
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07l.appSwitch.text: The app’s card has an «On» switch: an app turned off starts in no chat. The inspector has a journal: when the app used secrets and connections, when you agreed to its access.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07l.appCompat.text: Apps that worked before keep working after an update: features are only added, granted rights stay.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07k.sinopiaChatLef: While a design is edited its chat stands as a column on the left and does not cover the page. Place it otherwise and Sinopia keeps your choice.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07j.annotate.title: Annotations on the page
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07j.annotate.text: In the pane's browser press «Annotate» and click elements: each gets a number and a short comment row. Marks stay on their elements as the page scrolls, and the mode stays on after a click.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07j.annotateSend.t: A bar «Annotating · N» stands at the foot of the page: hide the marks, delete all or send. The agent gets every element under its number, with your comment.
Annotations as chips in the field
Each sent annotation lands in the chat field as a chip of its own: hover to see the page and element, edit the comment or delete it. They go to the agent with your message.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07i.tidyMenu.title: A shorter menu on the left
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07i.tidyMenu.text: Sinopia and Apps no longer unfold their lists by themselves: the latest open by the arrow. «More» is a menu beside the item. The footer keeps the profile and the notification bell; theme and machines are in settings.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07i.fullTitle.text: Point at a cut title in the list to see it whole.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07h.longMessages.t: A very long text goes to the agent as a file: the chat shows its start and the file with the whole message. The queue joins messages only up to a sane length, the rest follow one by one. A message the agent still does not take comes back to the queue marked at once instead of hanging «in the agent’s queue».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07g.kitFile.title: A design system as one file
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07g.kitFile.text: In the design system picker press «Add a design system» and choose a file: every hash is checked, nothing is overwritten, and if that version is already there you see how it differs. Export a system to a file with design kit export.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07g.kitFonts.title: Design system fonts in a deck
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07g.kitFonts.text: The Style panel of a deck and a video now lists the fonts of installed design systems; the system's version is pinned, so the deck looks the same later.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07g.kitLayouts.tit: Slide layouts from a design system
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07g.kitLayouts.tex: The «＋ slide» button in the deck strip now lists the layouts of installed systems: the slide is made from the layout at once.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07f.appHeader.text: At the top of an app: a switch between the chats it is on in and a new chat with it in one click; «Share» copies a link for teammates, settings are under «…».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07e.appsDebug.text: A «Debug» switch in «Apps»: any app shows the calls it makes, why one was refused and the errors in its window.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07d.appViewsLoad.t: An app's window no longer stops at a blank page: its scripts load, and the chat's agent sees its buttons and forms.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07c.liveFallback.t: A site the proxy could not load opens in the machine’s browser

When one of your own sites or stands does not answer the pane’s proxy (a reset, a timeout, a certificate), the tab switches to the machine’s real browser by itself and opens the same address. Nothing to toggle.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07b.uploadFiles.te: In the Files tab drag files or a whole folder into the list or press «Upload». You see the percent, the speed and the time left; an upload can be cancelled or retried.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07b.anySize.title: Files of any size
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07b.anySize.text: Drag a file into the chat or paste it with Ctrl+V — there is no size limit but the free space on the machine. If the connection drops, the upload goes on from where it stopped.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07b.newFolder.text: Create a folder right in the Files tab: with the button or from the menu, typing the name in the list.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07a.lessonRing.tex: A lesson rings the very button or block on the mockup, keeps off it and says when the mockup is still loading. Leave the lesson’s page and it waits and takes you back.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07a.lessonPick.tex: The lesson goes in order: pick the heading, write a note, send it to the agent. The chat docks beside the mockup and the request runs on a fast model; «Pick» works right after editing is turned on.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zl.appSafeMode.t: One switch in «Apps»: new chats start without apps, except those the organization pinned. Handy when an app gets in the way. A chat whose app was removed now starts too.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zk.appPrecheck.t: The catalog tells beforehand whether an app fits
Before you install an app from a catalog you see whether it fits: whether it needs another harnessly, whether its command or document type is taken, and which secrets it will ask for.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zj.appState.titl: You see why an app is silent
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zj.appState.text: The apps list and «About» say what an app waits for: a secret, a sign-in or another harnessly version. A failed update keeps the previous working version.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zi.pageTools.tit: The agent works through the app
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zi.pageTools.tex: An app can hand the agent its own buttons and forms: the chat's agent fills a form or picks a row right in the open app window and sees what it shows now.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zi.remoteViews.t: An app from its own site
An app window can live on the app's own site: it opens in harnessly with its own sign-in and data and still works with the chat like a built-in one.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zh.tabsTidy.text: An empty tab closes as soon as you leave it. One left alone for 15 minutes goes too, unless something waits there: an agent at work, a question, an unread reply or a draft keep it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zh.tabsFront.tex: A chat where the agent asks or needs a permission moves to the front of the tab strip, followed by chats with an unread reply.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zh.appCatalog.ti: The agent knows what an app can do
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zh.appCatalog.te: Writing a plugin with an agent, it no longer guesses names of places and rights: harnessly app catalog and the catalog tool list where an app fits in, which rights it needs and what they open.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zh.appsInPlus.te: No more row of chips over the field. Turn a chat's apps on and off in «+» → «App»: the ones on carry a check.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zg.learn.title: Learn
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zg.learn.text: «More» → «Learn»: ten short lessons with films — the chat, the right pane, Sinopia, the safe and several agents. A lesson leads through the real interface and counts a step once you've done it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zg.demo.title: Demo projects in Sinopia
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zg.demo.text: Relay's site, deck, film and design system are already in the library — try and break them, they can be brought back.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zg.fileHead.titl: The file head in one row
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zg.fileHead.text: Over a file open in the right pane there is now one row: the path on the left, «Edit | Preview», «Share» and «Save» on the right. PDFs, pictures, spreadsheets and Word documents have the same. On a narrow pane a long path shrinks with an ellipsis.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zf.codexApps.tex: Apps now work in Codex chats as well: the same rules, instructions and servers as in Claude Code. What an app's rule forbids, the agent does not do.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zf.appConnection: An app can reach the tracker or GitLab as you, through «Connections». You allow it the connection in the app's «Setup» and take it back there too.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zf.appJournal.te: When an app stops the agent or asks you first, the feed shows which app and which rule. All its decisions are in «About the app».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06ze.envApps.title: Apps for everyone through the environment
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06ze.envApps.text: An organization admin adds an app from a repository folder to the environment, a design system or presentation templates, say. Everyone gets it; nobody can remove it, and a pinned one cannot be turned off.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06ze.envForms.titl: Plugins and Claude settings by a form
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06ze.envForms.text: «Add to the environment» now has an app, a Claude Code plugin and Claude settings: no files and no command line.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zd.envPresets.te: A preset is a set of groups you pick with one click: the groups it names turn on and the other optional ones turn off. Layer editors build the presets, so you no longer flip groups one by one.
In the hub’s «Environment» a group is now a folder: you see what is in it and how much, and it folds away. The group decides who gets its items, so they no longer have a switch of their own.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06zb.basePackage.t: The machine gets ready by itself

Right after it joins the hub, the machine installs in the background what an agent needs: git, tmux, ffmpeg, Node, ripgrep and more. No network access — the «Basics» stage of the card lets you give a proxy or skip the item.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06z.viewQuiet.text: In the «Design» mode the Sinopia apps' panels, the selection menu and the checks' marks on the pages go too: the design itself is left. «Editing» brings them back.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06z.keyStep.title: A key step in an ordinary tab
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06z.keyStep.text: When a sign-in in the pane asks for a security key or Touch ID, a bar over the page offers «Open in an ordinary tab»: take the step there, and the page in the pane reloads by itself when you come back.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06y.recommended.te: Turn on the «Recommended» group in «Environment» and your machine installs Superpowers, Context7, Playwright, Chrome DevTools and economical Claude settings. Turn it off and what was installed stays.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06x.envGroups.text: Repositories, skills and MCP in the hub’s «Environment» gather into groups. A required group goes to everyone; an optional one each person turns on for themselves.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06x.envApply.title: «Apply on the machines»
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06x.envApply.text: One button in «Environment» updates the team’s machines: now, or at their next start so nobody at work is interrupted.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06w.chatWidgets.te: The agent can now draw a chart, a table or an app's card straight in the feed and update it in place while it works: the card under the step changes instead of a new message.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06w.appsAlways.tex: A plugin can be on in every new chat, or turn on by its own command such as /tasks: no need to switch it on by hand each time.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06w.appsSafer.text: An app asks for its keys and settings in «About the app»: a key goes into the machine's safe and reaches neither the agent nor the app's window. An app's prohibitions now hold in the agent itself.
The preview works on one address
When a company gives harnessly one address and no subdomains, the preview of local servers still opens in the pane. Nothing to set up.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06.docsLibrary.tex: «More → Documentation» now has sections for people, for agents, the architecture with diagrams and self-hosting, with screenshots. The search looks through the text of every page.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06.docsTeam.title: Your team's own documentation
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06.docsTeam.text: Put pages into the machine’s documentation folder and they show next to the built-in ones without a rebuild: runbooks, how your services are wired, your conventions.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06.docsAgents.titl: Agents read and add to the docs
next.whatsNew.2026-11-06.docsAgents.text: An agent looks the answer up with harnessly docs, and when you ask, writes a new page down with screenshots and diagrams.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05r.setupCard.titl: Machine setup on the start page
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05r.setupCard.text: While the machine sets up the team's environment, the start page shows what goes on, what failed and what is wanted of you. «Retry» runs it again.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05r.reposSkill.tex: The team's repositories no longer take a skill each in every chat: the agent sees one list with folders and addresses.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05q.envScripts.tit: Scripts and access in the environment
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05q.envScripts.tex: The hub's «Environment» now takes scripts for people's machines, reordered by drag. Access is connected by the organization admin.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05q.envSandbox.tit: Check the environment in a sandbox
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05q.envSandbox.tex: «Check» sets the environment up from scratch in a separate sandbox and shows what failed and why. «Logs» keeps the last 14 days.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05q.envMachine.tex: A member sees whether their machine is ready or out of date and updates it with one button.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05p.modeSwitch.tit: View and edit, as a clear switch
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05p.modeSwitch.tex: Instead of one button that showed the current mode one moment and the next one the other, the design now has a «View | Edit» switch: you see where you are and where to go.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05p.shareSmooth.te: The tabs of the «Share» dialog switch at once and smoothly, even when many people have access.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05p.designLinks.ti: Links from a design's chat open beside it
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05p.designLinks.te: A document, link or card from a design's chat now opens in the pane beside the design instead of a new browser tab. Cmd/Ctrl+click still opens it in the browser.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05p.agentFiles.tit: «Open file» on an agent's card works
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05p.agentFiles.tex: A file from a background agent's card opens in a design's chat too: beside the design or in its chat's «Files».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05n.designChats.ti: Design chats from all your machines
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05n.designChats.te: The switch in a design's chat now lists its chats from all your machines; a chat of another machine opens where it runs. Only chats started from the design or that edited its files are listed, not the ones that merely opened it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05m.askAccess.titl: «Request access» goes straight to the owner
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05m.askAccess.text: In the viewing mode «Request access» opens «Share» with the request ready: pick comment or edit and add a word. It reaches the owner and those who run the access, who allow or deny it in the same window.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05h.shareEverywher: Decks, videos, documents and boards open the same window as a design: people and teams in one field, your team first, a link without sign-in for each recipient.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05h.docLinks.title: A document that cannot be copied
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05h.docLinks.text: A link to a document can turn off downloading and copying text: the guest reads it on screen but cannot take it away.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05h.deckLinks.titl: A deck opens the way you meant
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05h.deckLinks.text: A link to a deck sets the slide it starts from and how it opens; a video's link sets the format, autoplay and comments on the timeline.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05f.liveTools.titl: The agent works on outside sites too
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05f.liveTools.text: On a page open in the machine’s browser the agent sees what can be acted on, clicks, types, scrolls, reads the page’s and a video’s state and waits for an event, such as the end of a clip, as on your own servers. You see its cursor; it never types passwords or card details.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05g.castFast.title: The machine browser responds faster
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05g.castFast.text: Frames from the machine browser arrive as fast as the pane can show them, so scrolling and typing no longer pile up and catch up seconds later. Wheel and mouse moves are gathered into one step per frame. Once the page is still, it is shown at the full sharpness of your screen.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05d.agentCards.tex: When background agents finish, the feed shows their task and when, not an internal name. The card is quiet, folded to a couple of lines and opens on a click; files in the report are short chips that open in the pane. Several agents at once are one card.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05b.noAsk.title: The agent acts on the page with no questions and no banners
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05b.noAsk.text: The «Allow/Deny» and «The agent is working» bars are gone: the agent acts on any site at once, and all you see is its cursor. The sites it may not touch are set in Settings → General.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05a.liveBrowser.ti: Outside sites in a real browser
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05a.liveBrowser.te: Google, search and other outside sites open in the pane through the machine’s own browser, as they are, with no rewriting. Your servers and stands still go through the proxy with DevTools.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04z.browserAsk.tit: The agent waits for your go-ahead on a site
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04z.browserAsk.tex: While you decide whether to let the agent act on a page, its tools no longer fail: it sees it is waiting for your answer about this site and carries on after «Allow».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04y.findInFiles.te: In Files, press ⇧⌘F (Ctrl+Shift+F) or the text search button: matching lines are grouped by file, and a click opens the file at that line with the text selected.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04y.gitMarks.title: What changed shows in the list
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04y.gitMarks.text: Files changed and not committed are coloured in Files, new ones in green. A folder is marked when something inside it changed.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04y.fileOps.title: New file, rename, move to trash
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04y.fileOps.text: Files has a New file button, and the «…» menu of a file or folder has Rename and Move to trash. What you remove is not erased at once: it goes to the machine's trash. A file or folder opens in a tab of its own from «…» or with ⌘-click.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04x.claudeConfigDi: Agent replies show up right away

A new chat's message no longer hangs as “waiting in line” after the agent has answered: the reply reaches the feed in seconds, not a minute later. This also works on machines where Claude Code or Codex keep their data outside the home folder, as is common on Coder.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04w.machineFiles.t: Disk is now part of Files

The Project / Machine switch shows the whole machine in the same list. Upload files with a button or by dropping them, and make a new folder there. An open file's header is one row now, and selected code offers Ask the agent right beside it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04w.quickOpen.text: In Files, press ⌘P (Ctrl+P) or the magnifier and type a name: the project's file is found by its letters and opens on Enter.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04w.phoneFiles.tex: Hold a row to pick several files and download them as one archive. The «…» menu opens from below, and a diff shows inside the text.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04u.teleportApps.t: A site behind a Teleport sign-in, such as PostHog, opens in the pane's browser: when the Teleport address is in the pane's list of sites, the tab goes through the single sign-on by itself and comes back to the site under your own account. When a site does not answer, the pane says where it stopped: no connection from the machine, or the site is silent.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04t.fullQuiet.text: A design from the chat's pane opens full screen without side panels: they come out only when you open them.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04s.modeLeft.title: The mode sits by the name
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04s.modeLeft.text: «Design» or «Editing» is now on the left, by the address: a click switches the mode. Only the tools stay on the right.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04r.sinopiaDownloa: The Download button on the bar: this page as a PDF, one HTML file or a PNG, all pages as a PDF, the whole project as a ZIP. A deck and a video have their formats in the same menu. A page also downloads from the list of pages or a right click on its tab.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04q.vaultLogin.tit: Sign in from the safe in the pane's browser
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04q.vaultLogin.tex: When the safe holds a password for the site open in the pane, the key button in the browser's bar signs you in: pick the account and the page fills its form itself. Neither the chat nor the agent sees the password.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04p.siteHops.title: Sign-in to our sites stays in the pane
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04p.siteHops.text: When one of our sites sends you to another of ours, such as its sign-in page and back, the pane's tab follows by itself, with no «Open in preview» page. Other sites still wait for a press.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04o.siteTools.titl: The agent uses the site's own tools
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04o.siteTools.text: When a site offers tools to agents itself (WebMCP), the agent in the pane calls them instead of clicking through its pages: faster and steadier. It asks for the site the same way.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04n.shareOne.title: A new Share window in design
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04n.shareOne.text: Add people and whole teams in one field and give them one role; the term and “Can share” are in the role menu. Viewers can ask to edit.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04n.shareTeams.tex: Remove the team from a project and bring it back in one click. A team lead can hand the project over too.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04n.publishInShare: There is one button in the top bar. The site is published from the last section of the Share window: name, who may open it, pages — and after publishing, the address with Copy and Open.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.devtools.title: DevTools for any page in the pane
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.devtools.text: A button in the pane's browser opens the console, network and elements of the page: a stand, the admin, any of our sites. One click puts a console error into the chat's field.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.inspect.title: Element to chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.inspect.text: In Elements, hover the page and pick an element: you see its markup and styles, and one click puts a line about it into the chat's field for the agent.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.chatMode.title: The project's mode stays with its chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.chatMode.text: A design, presentation, video or document opened from a chat comes back in the same mode after a reload or a return, and opens for editing the first time. The bar says where you are: «Editing the design» or just «Design».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04m.diff.title: Compare files
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04m.diff.text: An open file's «…» menu has Compare with git: changes show side by side or inline. Two files checked in Files compare with the Compare button.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04m.askCode.title: Ask the agent about code
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04m.askCode.text: Select code in the editor and press Ask the agent, Explain or Fix. The selection, with its path and line numbers, goes to the chat field. Find and replace opens from the magnifier button.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.netPill.title: «No connection» on a phone
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.netPill.text: The reconnect pill fits a narrow screen: its button no longer runs off the edge.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04l.phonePill.text: A small panel stands to the right of the phone on the canvas: turn it, hide the frame, the status bar or the browser bar, and switch on “Touch” — hover then does nothing, as on a real phone. Drag the panel anywhere or hide it with a right click.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04k.offlineSend.ti: Write even when the machine is away
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04k.offlineSend.te: While the machine restarts or is off, a message waits in the chat and goes by itself when it is back. You can edit or delete it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04k.offlineVoice.t: Dictation does not depend on the machine
Stop and cancel always work. Without a link the recording is kept and recognized by itself when the machine is back.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04j.agentBrowser.t: The agent works with the page in the pane
Ask the agent to go through a flow or fill in a form on a stand: it clicks, types and scrolls in the browser tab, and you see its cursor. «Stop» is on the strip above the page.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04j.agentAsk.title: It asks first
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04j.agentAsk.text: Before its first action on a new site the agent asks you, and the answer is kept for the site. It never types passwords or card details. The sites are in Settings → General.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04i.fileMenu.title: A «…» menu on every file
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04i.fileMenu.text: Download, Open in a new tab, Ask the agent and Copy path are on each row in Files and above an open file. On the phone the menu opens from the bottom.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04i.viewers.title: More formats in Files
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04i.viewers.text: JSON shows as a tree, SVG as a picture, a font as a specimen. Files inside a tar or tar.gz are listed. An HTML page loads its styles, scripts and pictures from the files beside it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04h.download.title: Download any file or folder
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04h.download.text: Every row in Files has a Download button. A folder downloads as a zip, and you can pick several files at once. There is no size limit, and a broken download resumes.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04h.htmlPage.title: HTML opens as a page
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04h.htmlPage.text: An HTML file shows as a page; switch to Code for the source. Files outside the chat folder open in Files too and download from there.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04g.pick.title: Comment on a page element
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04g.pick.text: In the pane browser press «Pick an element and comment», click a button or a block and say what to change: the agent gets the element, its component and your comment.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04g.devices.title: See a page as on a phone
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04g.devices.text: The «Device» menu shows the page on a phone or a tablet, and «Rotate» puts the screen on its side. «Open in the browser» takes the page to your own browser.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04f.links.title: Links from the chat open
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04f.links.text: Another site opens in a new tab of the browser, ours (documents, boards, stands, the tracker) in the pane on the right. With ⌘ or Ctrl a link always opens in the browser. Which sites open in the pane is in Settings → General.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04f.linkMenu.title: A menu on a link
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04f.linkMenu.text: A right click or a long press on a link: «Open in the pane», «Open in the browser», «Copy link».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04e.viewMode.title: Projects open in view mode
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04e.viewMode.text: Designs, decks, videos and documents open without the chat and tools, the way people you share with see them. «Edit» is in the top bar; without edit rights it reads «Request access». Expanding from a chat opens editing at once. On a phone there is one thin bar.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04e.swipeToast.tex: With a finger on the phone, two fingers on a trackpad or a held mouse button — sideways or up. The buttons of queued messages are always shown again.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04e.livePages.text: When an agent renames or adds a page, the tabs on top change without a reload.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04d.fitRotate.text: «Fit» (or ⌘0) brings back the usual view: a phone or tablet whole and centred, «Fit to window» filling the window. Phones and tablets can be turned sideways.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04d.voiceRetry.tex: «Recognize» shows its progress, a long recording is recognized in parts by the same engine as dictation, and an unrecognized recording stays in its own chat.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04d.boardError.tit: A board error to the chat in one press
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04d.boardError.tex: Every button on «The board did not render» works, and «Send to chat» puts the error in the field so the agent can find and fix it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04c.sidebar.title: A smoother sidebar
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04c.sidebar.text: It folds in one motion, the chat under the pointer stays the same, and the logo or any empty spot opens it again. Dragging favorites no longer jumps.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04c.askCard.title: Tidier agent questions
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04c.askCard.text: The question, the queue and the field are now one block of one width, and nothing wraps or overlaps in the narrow chat beside a design.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04c.startAttach.ti: Attach anything from the start page
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04c.startAttach.te: The «+» menu on the start page has the same items as in a chat: a design, a document, a board, a task or MR, apps. An attached design just goes into the field.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04b.designChat.tit: The design chat: its place and handoff
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04b.designChat.tex: Pick where the chat stands from a labelled list in its header. Its «⋯» menu continues the chat in another model or on another machine, and the new chat stays beside the design.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04b.designCanvas.t: The design sits in the window with no dark frame, and the view is locked from the start. Drag the zoom pill anywhere, right-click it for its settings or to hide it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04b.allScreens.tex: Sizes come in groups: phones, tablets, computers. «All screens» shows the design on every device side by side, scrolling them together.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04a.deckTerminal.t: A terminal in the project chat
In Sinopia the agent's terminal now opens right from the chat of a deck, a video or a mockup.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04a.startFiles.tex: In the field of a new project, paste a screenshot or drag it in, and the picture shows at once.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-04.officialLogos.t: YouTrack, Yandex Tracker, Azure DevOps, MediaWiki, monday and Context7 now show their own logos in Connections too, not letters.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03h.brandIcons.tex: In Settings → Connections and the MCP server catalog, Jira, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma and the rest now show their own logos.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03f.characters.tex: Ask for a cartoon: characters breathe, blink, talk, wave and cheer, charts draw themselves, confetti flies.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03f.record.title: Interface recording with a cursor
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03f.record.text: The agent films your site from a script in sharp quality, draws a smooth cursor and zooms the camera to where you click and type.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03f.overlays.title: Captions and callouts on video
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03f.overlays.text: Add titles, lower thirds and callouts right in the player: drag, resize from a corner, double-click to change the text. The agent's edits show up there too.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03e.mcpFlow.title: Connecting an MCP server, no surprises
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03e.mcpFlow.text: Pick a service or paste your own address and adjust it if needed: the sign-in window opens only when you press «Sign in with …».
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03d.connections.ti: Your tracker and wiki, by link
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03d.connections.te: Paste a link to Jira, Confluence, YouTrack, Linear, GitLab or GitHub in Settings → Connections: harnessly figures out the rest and asks only for a token.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03d.agentsRead.tit: Agents read your tasks and pages
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03d.agentsRead.tex: Once connected, an agent opens a task or a wiki page by its link or key and reads it with your access, in the cloud or on your own server.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03d.mcp.title: Connect MCP servers in one sign-in
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03d.mcp.text: Atlassian, Linear, Notion, Sentry and your own servers: sign in right in Settings → Connections, and agents in new chats get their tools.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03c.docs.title: Documentation inside the product
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03c.docs.text: A «Documentation» section under «More»: how to write your own app, with examples and diagrams. In Russian and English.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03b.queueNote.text: When the agent is stopped, the reason and “Resume sending” no longer overlap.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03b.gates.title: Agent requests always show in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03b.gates.text: A plan, a permission or any other window the agent waits on now comes as a card, even with a very low terminal under the chat.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03a.files.title: The agent gets any file you attach
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03a.files.text: A PDF, an archive, a sheet or a text file attached to a message now reaches the agent, not just pictures. Up to 50 MB each.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02q.paneOverview.t: Overview in the pane shows every device whole
A site, deck or video beside the chat takes the pane's full height, and the devices in Overview are evenly spaced and no longer cut off at the edges.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02q.playerMoment.t: An open video no longer attaches itself to your message
The agent gets a moment only when you moved the paused video there or marked a stretch.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02p.oneStart.title: Sites, slides and videos start from one screen
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02p.oneStart.text: In Sinopia a tile no longer takes you to another screen: the kind changes, the field and your text stay. Files, settings and voice work for every kind.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02o.videoSeek.titl: Seeking a Sinopia video works the first time
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02o.videoSeek.text: The video editor no longer freezes when first opened: the picture follows the playhead, and the next scene loads in time.
No account or command needed: boards run on the built-in engine with an API key or Codex too. The Anthropic engine is optional, in Settings.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02n.limitReset.tit: After a limit the chat goes on by itself
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02n.limitReset.tex: Hit your plan's limit — the chat waits for the reset and sends your message, no need to pick another model.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02m.language.title: Change the language in Settings
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02m.language.text: In «Settings → General → Language» pick Русский or English: the interface switches at once, no reinstall. This browser remembers the choice.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02m.longCommand.ti: Long commands get buttons in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02m.longCommand.te: A request to run a long command no longer sends you to the terminal: you can allow it right on the card. It goes to the terminal only when a small terminal is open and the command does not fit.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02l.office.title: Word and PowerPoint open right in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02l.office.text: A document looks like paper, a presentation like slides with a strip below. Edit the text in place and it saves itself. Select a paragraph or click a shape, and the agent knows what you mean.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02l.history.title: Files update by themselves, with earlier versions at hand
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02l.history.text: When the agent changes an open file, the new version shows at once and your edits go on top. The clock button brings back any recent state of a spreadsheet, document or presentation.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02k.selection.titl: The agent sees what you select in a file
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02k.selection.text: Select cells, text in a PDF, a moment of a video or a region of a picture: a mark appears above the field and goes to the agent with your message. Drag with Shift for a stretch of a video or a region of a picture. The agent can show you a place in a file too.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02k.sheet.title: Spreadsheets open and edit in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02k.sheet.text: Excel and CSV in the pane: sheets, formulas, styles and frozen rows as in the file. An edit saves itself, and the sum of a selection shows below.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02j.hubMoney.title: Agent spend and results in the hub
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02j.hubMoney.text: What the organization, a tenant and a team spent, how much is left of the limit and what the money gives: MRs, completion, the effect of each change. Rolling out in the hub gradually.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02j.hubMachines.te: Who is online, whose runner is old, what sits idle. Restart a runner or disable a machine right from the hub.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02i.deckApps.title: Apps in presentations
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02i.deckApps.text: Select a block on a slide and the app's bar (such as «Shorten» in the deck validator) shows up over the field. The checks' marks are drawn on the blocks themselves.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02h.player.title: Video and sound play in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02h.player.text: A file from the agent opens in the pane in its own player: seeking with a frame under the pointer, speed, full screen. Sound shows its wave.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02h.pdf.title: PDFs open properly
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02h.pdf.text: Pages, contents, thumbnails and search through the whole file, right in the pane. Pictures now zoom with the wheel and a double click.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02g.appDocs.title: Documents of app types in the library
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02g.appDocs.text: Documents of the types apps add now appear in the library beside the chat and open there. One you may only view opens in its editor, read-only.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02g.appsWall.title: Apps stay behind the wall
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02g.appsWall.text: The agent of a chat with an app can no longer open a terminal or a new chat, read the runtime's keys or change your settings and shell profile. sudo and Docker are off in such a chat: use a chat without apps or a terminal for them.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02f.language.title: Change the language in Settings
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02f.language.text: In «Settings → General → Language» pick Русский or English: the interface switches at once, no reinstall. This browser remembers the choice.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02e.longCommand.ti: Long commands get buttons in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02e.longCommand.te: A request to run a long command no longer sends you to the terminal: you can allow it right on the card. It goes to the terminal only when a small terminal is open and the command does not fit.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02e.enterAnswers.t: Fold the question and write your answer in the field: Enter sends it, no need to look for the button on the card.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02d.longVoice.text: A recording of several minutes is no longer cut off halfway. Press «Recognize» over the field and the text appears in it.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02d.sinopiaSize.ti: Sinopia no longer shrinks to a strip
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02d.sinopiaSize.te: The canvas in the right pane no longer sticks at a size too small to use: such a size resets by itself.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02d.pictureList.te: When the agent lists pictures, the answer no longer shows empty «1.» and «2.»: the pictures stand under the text.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02c.motion.title: Real animation in videos
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02c.motion.text: Sinopia videos now have proper motion graphics: camera moves, drawn lines, motion with weight, text word by word. Ask for a cartoon or an explainer.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02c.show.title: The agent shows you the moment
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02c.show.text: The agent moves your player to the right moment. If you are moving it just then, it offers a Show button instead.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03g.pictureEdit.ti: Edit pictures right in the viewer
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03g.pictureEdit.te: Open a picture from a chat: mark it up, comment on an area, erase, remove the background, change the format or say what to change. Every edit is a new version and the original stays.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-03g.sinopiaHover.t: Hover a picture in a deck or a design and press «Edit». An empty place for a picture offers «Generate»; the block stays blurred while it is drawn.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02.manage.title: Manage stops flickering
next.whatsNew.2026-11-02.manage.text: The page no longer vanishes behind a placeholder while chats are working. On a machine connected to a hub, the way there sits right in the page tabs.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31k.appsMain.title: An app on the whole screen
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31k.appsMain.text: Open an app from its tab on the right on the whole screen: the chat stays beside it — at the left, in a window over it, or as one field at the foot. Turn an app on in a chat from «+» → «App»; the chat's apps stand over the field.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31h.images.title: Pictures right in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31h.images.text: Ask the agent to draw a picture and Codex generates it; the feed shows it coming in from blur. Ask for several variants at once.
Select a picture or a block on a slide or a design and press «Generate a picture»: it lands in place. Not quite right? «Draw again».
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31i.words.title: Dictation knows your words
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31i.words.text: Settings → Voice input has «My words»: add Sinopia or harnessly and «открой синопию в харнесли» is written as «открой Sinopia в harnessly». Give a word with the ways it is heard, or leave it to be found by sound.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31i.models.title: Pick the recognition model
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31i.models.text: Besides the model on the machine, dictation can use OpenAI gpt-4o-transcribe or Yandex SpeechKit, and the text still comes into the field as you speak. Keys are in Models and keys; a model without its key is unavailable, and the recording goes to the cloud only when a cloud model is picked.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31j.keys.title: Keys for dictation and the field
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31j.keys.text: ⌘⇧Space starts and finishes a dictation, Esc finishes it and keeps the text. There are keys to send now, stop the agent and attach a file; all are in the ⌘/ sheet and changeable in Keys.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31h.words.title: Dictation knows your words
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31h.words.text: Settings → Voice input has «My words»: add Sinopia or harnessly and «открой синопию в харнесли» is written as «открой Sinopia в harnessly». Give a word with the ways it is heard, or leave it to be found by sound.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31h.models.title: Pick the recognition model
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31h.models.text: Besides the model on the machine, dictation can use OpenAI gpt-4o-transcribe or Yandex SpeechKit, and the text still comes into the field as you speak. Keys are in Models and keys; a model without its key is unavailable, and the recording goes to the cloud only when a cloud model is picked.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31g.quotaRetry.tex: When a model hit its limit, the button runs the stopped turn again, and the card says when the limit resets.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31g.keys.title: Shortcuts you can change
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31g.keys.text: Settings → «Shortcuts»: every shortcut by screen, each can be changed, the same on all your devices. They work in any layout; ⌘/ shows the sheet. New: new chat, newer/older chat, copy the answer, cursor to the field.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31g.step.title: Turn slides, scenes and pictures from the chat's field
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31g.step.text: ⌥← and ⌥→ turn a deck, a video or pictures open beside the chat without taking the cursor from the message field.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31e.questions.text: When the agent thought for a long while and then asked, the card with the choices now comes up over the field instead of hiding behind «working».
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31d.looks.title: Colour themes
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31d.looks.text: Settings → Appearance has seven palettes — Midnight, Forest, Sand, Rose, Lagoon, Contrast and the familiar Graphite — each in light and dark; the new colour spreads from where you click.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31d.notices.title: Notices where you want them
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31d.notices.text: Pick a corner and how soon a card hides by itself; «Show» puts a sample there at once. A card under the pointer stays.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31d.settings.title: Settings stay up
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31d.settings.text: Safe and Notifications open again, and the sections are in three groups: the app, the agents, the machine.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31c.createField.ti: A new deck's and video's field works like the chat's
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31c.createField.te: The field grows with the text and sends with the round button on the right. The design system, length, tone, prompter and video formats are behind one «Settings» button that says what is picked.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31c.shortMessage.t: A message of a couple of letters no longer stacks one letter per line.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31b.apps.title: Apps in a chat
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31b.apps.text: Ask the agent to turn an app on, such as MR review: it gets the app's instructions and skills, and cannot do what the app forbids.
next.whatsNew.title: What's new
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31f.gpt.title: GPT in Claude Code
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31f.gpt.text: Codex in «Models and keys» has a new switch: GPT models on your ChatGPT subscription become available in Claude Code chats. Regular Codex stays as it was.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31f.models.title: Simpler «Models and keys»
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31f.models.text: Each model has one line saying how it is connected. A connection check shows its result right on the button, and deleting a key stands apart, in red.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31.share.title: «Share» works the same everywhere
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31.share.text: In a design, a deck and a video, on their own page and in a chat's right pane, «Share» opens the access window: managers grant access, everyone else sees their role, asks for more or copies the link.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31.boardError.text: When a board fails, «Send to the chat», «Copy», «Next board» and «Hide» respond, and a hidden error does not pop up again.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-31.designsFold.tex: The chevron beside «Sinopia Design» hides and shows the designs. Only what is open is highlighted: the design or the chat.
Under «Sinopia Design» in the menu: the designs a chat works on now or did in the last day, and the open one.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30c.video.title: A full-size video
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30c.video.text: The video player takes the whole stage instead of shrinking to the width of its buttons.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30c.rail.title: The folded menu no longer sticks
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30c.rail.text: A menu opened by hovering folds when the pointer leaves, even with a design screen's own window open.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30c.layout.title: A design remembers its chat
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30c.layout.text: The chat beside a design stays where you left it: a column on either side, a window or the field below. Go to another chat and back, and it is all in place.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30b.designs.title: Design and chat as one
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30b.designs.text: The designs at work are under «Sinopia Design» in the menu. «Full width» on a design in a chat's pane opens it whole with the same chat, and the design's screen has the same right pane: browser, files, terminal.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30b.folders.title: Shorter folders
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30b.folders.text: A folder shows its five latest chats, the rest behind «More». The open chat always shows.
When you make a design, a deck or a video, pick the model and the machine — as for a new chat.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30.browser.title: A browser on your machine
next.whatsNew.2026-10-30.browser.text: A separate page shows a browser running on your machine and using its IP address. Tabs, cookies and sign-ins survive restarts.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28i.publish.title: Publish a site
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28i.publish.text: The Publish button in a design's header sends the pages to the hub, and they open at their own address even when the machine is off.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28h.terminal.title: Messages get through an open terminal menu
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28h.terminal.text: If the sign-in menu or the model picker was left open in the agent's terminal, the chat closes it, sends the message and says so under it.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28g.account.title: Which account a machine has
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28g.account.text: Models and keys and the sign-in card show which account Claude and Codex signed in with on this machine. If there are two, you get a warning: that can get the subscription blocked.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28e.takes.title: Recordings at hand
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28e.takes.text: «+» → «Recordings»: play, download or put the text into the field. All of them are in Settings → «Recordings».
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28e.keep.title: Recordings outlive the machine
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28e.keep.text: Recordings are kept apart from the machine: the audio for 30 days, the text for good.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28i.same.title: One sidebar for all machines
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28i.same.text: Every chat, folder and favorite, through any machine. The card at the bottom shows the open chat's machine.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28i.machine.title: The machine is in the model menu
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28i.machine.text: A new chat starts on your main machine. Pick another in the model menu — its agents and models show there.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28d.edit.title: Edit while dictating
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28d.edit.text: Edit the text by hand while you speak — nothing is written over at the stop. A new dictation goes where the caret is.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28d.kept.title: Recordings are not lost
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28d.kept.text: If the link to the machine drops, the recording is kept in the browser and waits over the field — recognized by itself once the machine is back, or with a button.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28c.login.title: Sign in right in the chat
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28c.login.text: When the Claude or Codex sign-in expires, the chat shows a «Sign in with subscription» button — no terminal, no hunting through settings. Once signed in, one button sends the message again.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28b.folders.title: Shared projects and favorites
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28b.folders.text: Folders and favorites are one for all your machines: nothing disappears when you switch.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28b.machine.title: A chat on any machine
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28b.machine.text: Pick the machine for a new chat under the greeting — by default the one picked in the sidebar.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28.one.title: All your chats in one list
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28.one.text: On any machine you see your chats from every machine — the others carry its name.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28.here.title: Continue here
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28.here.text: Open a chat from another machine and press “Continue here” — it moves here with its history.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28.off.title: History without the machine on
next.whatsNew.2026-10-28.off.text: A chat of a machine that is off opens read-only; continue once it is back on.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27b.safe.title: A safe for tokens
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27b.safe.text: An agent asks for a token with a «Put in the safe» window, not in the chat: the value is kept encrypted on the machine and goes into its commands.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27b.safeSettings.t: Settings → Safe: what is there, who used it and when, replace or remove.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27.telegram.title: Notifications in Telegram
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27.telegram.text: Link bots in Settings → Notifications — the agent writes when it is done or needs your answer.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27.full.title: Shared designs open full screen
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27.full.text: Guests see the design without panels, and comment on a phone by pressing and holding.
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27.version.title: Link to one version
next.whatsNew.2026-10-27.version.text: In «Share»: always the latest or this version — and only the pages you choose.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05e.guestLinks.tit: A link without sign-in for each person
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05e.guestLinks.tex: «Share» of a design has «Links without sign-in»: who the link is for, view or comment, how long. Copy it any time, switch it off and on again, and see whether it was opened.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05e.guestLinkSetti: «More» of a link: on a computer or a phone, which pages and which version — this one or always the latest.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-05e.siteAddress.te: «Publish as a site» remembers the published site after the page reloads.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07za.machinePick.t: Switch machines even when one is down
A new chat starts on the first machine that answers, and the model and machine picker stays in the field. When none answers, the field says so.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-07za.machineStatus: The machine's status is always in the chat header
Its icon shows even when all is well: hover it for the name and state.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09k.kitCanvas.text: Every kit in the library has its own screen: a tree on the left, all components, layouts and icons on one canvas, search on ⌘K. On the right: parameters with a live preview, how to call it, insert into a board and send to chat.
next.whatsNew.2026-11-09k.kitInProject.t: The project bar shows the kit and its version, a slide from the kit has «Open in the kit» and «Show the layout», and the kit shows where each layout is used.
